players.product: Neoverse V2/V3 CPU core IP and CSS compute subsystems

quarterly_data.signal: Arm's quarterly report on Form 6-K (three months ended June 30, 2026): as of June 30, 2026 the aggregate transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations was $2,122.6 million (potential future royalties excluded); Arm expects to recognize approximately 24% of it as revenue over the next 12 months, 23% over the subsequent 13- to 24-month period and the remainder thereafter.

Arm's Q1 FY2027 6-K on Arm China, through which substantially all of Arm's PRC-related revenue is generated (intellectual property license agreement, IPLA): revenue under the IPLA with Arm China was $189.4 million in the quarter vs $201.0 million a year earlier. License revenue from Arm China decreased on the timing and size of high-value license agreements, while royalty revenue from Arm China increased on an improved mix of products with higher royalty rates per chip. Arm also terminated an outsourced-services agreement with Arm China during the quarter, recognizing $6.8 million of contract termination costs.
quarterly_data.figure: Arm China IPLA revenue $189.4 million vs $201.0 million

quarterly_data.signal: Arm's Q1 FY2027 6-K on Ampere (acquired by SoftBank Group in November 2025): Arm continues to have licensing and servicing arrangements with Ampere and recognized revenue of $5.4 million from Ampere in the three months ended June 30, 2026 vs $0.6 million a year earlier. Effective March 2026 Arm also entered into a development agreement with Ampere (the Ampere Development Agreement), under which Ampere provides development services to Arm under one or more statements of work; Arm recognized expenses of $5.0 million under it in the quarter.
quarterly_data.figure: Ampere revenue $5.4 million (year-ago $0.6 million); $5.0 million development-services expense

quarterly_data.signal: Arm's Q1 FY2027 6-K: on July 1, 2026 Arm completed the acquisition of 100% of DreamBig Semiconductor, Inc.; Arm states that DreamBig's advanced networking capabilities, technology and engineering expertise are expected to enhance its portfolio and help it deliver more complete solutions.

connects_to.relationship: Technology licensing and design services agreement supporting SoftBank's AI compute build-out

contracts.signal: Arm's Q1 FY2027 6-K: revenue from the Consulting Agreement with a SoftBank Group affiliate was $192.9 million in the three months ended June 30, 2026 vs $126.1 million a year earlier; at June 30, 2026 Arm held current contract assets of $576.1 million and non-current contract assets of $1.1 million from that affiliate (current contract assets were $645.8 million at March 31, 2026).
